label: NATIONS LEAGUE · BRAGA
headline: Life after Ronaldo starts with a 4–1 hammering
sub: Højlund scored twice. Portugal's heaviest-ever competitive home defeat, in their first game since Ronaldo retired from international football.
caption:
😳 Portugal 1–4 Denmark.

The first game since Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football ended in Portugal's heaviest-ever competitive home defeat. Pierre-Emile Højbjerg scored a penalty, Rasmus Højlund got two and Joachim Andersen headed in the fourth.

How much will Portugal miss Ronaldo? 👇

label: FRIENDLY · SINGAPORE
headline: Japan win it in the 91st minute
sub: Kubo and Nakamura put Japan 2–0 up, Vinícius Júnior scored twice to level, then Sakamoto won it. Raphinha was sent off.
caption:
🇯🇵 Japan 3–2 Brazil.

Takefusa Kubo and Keito Nakamura scored early, Vinícius Júnior hit back with two long-range goals, and Tatsuhiro Sakamoto won it in stoppage time after a VAR check. Raphinha was sent off a minute later.

Is Japan the best team in Asia right now? 👇

#Japan #Brazil #Vinicius

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · OSLO
headline: Haaland pen seals it in Oslo
sub: Nusa and Schjelderup scored before Brooks pulled one back. Haaland's penalty took his Nations League record to 23 goals. Wales will finish bottom of Group A4.
caption:
🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 Tough night for Wales in Oslo.

Norway won 3–1 with goals from Antonio Nusa, Andreas Schjelderup and an Erling Haaland penalty, his 23rd Nations League goal (a record). David Brooks scored for Wales, who now face a possible relegation play-off in March.

Can Wales stay in League A? 👇

#Wales #Haaland #NationsLeague

🇬🇧🇮🇪 Saturday's Nations League scorecard.

Northern Ireland beat Ukraine 1–0 thanks to a Terry Devlin strike from outside the box. Ireland lost 1–0 in Austria to a late Sasa Kalajdzic goal, and Wales went down 3–1 in Norway.
